questions.stem: The recommended seed rate for wheat is $$ 50 \text{ Kg/ha} $$. What will be the amount of seed of an area $$ 60 \text{m} $$ by $$ 50 \text{m} $$?
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Calculate the area in square meters.**
Area = $$ 60 \text{m} \times 50 \text{m} = 3000 \text{ m}^2 $$

**Step 2: Convert hectare to square meters.**
$$ 1 \text{ hectare (ha)} = 10,000 \text{ m}^2 $$

**Step 3: Use the ratio to find the seed amount.**
Seed amount = $$ \left( \frac{3000 \text{ m}^2}{10,000 \text{ m}^2} \right) \times 50 \text{ Kg} $$
Seed amount = $$ 0.3 \times 50 \text{ Kg} = 15 \text{ Kg} $$

similar_questions.stem: If the recommended seeding rate of maize is $$ 180kg $$ per hectare, what will be the amount of seed required in $$ 20m \times 16m $$ land?
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Calculate the area of the land.**
$$ Area = Length \times Width = 20m \times 16m = 320m^2 $$

**Step 2: Convert hectare to square meters.**
$$ 1 \text{ hectare} = 10,000m^2 $$

**Step 3: Calculate the seed required.**
$$ \text{Seed} = \frac{\text{Area} \times \text{Rate}}{\text{Hectare}} = \frac{320m^2 \times 180kg}{10,000m^2} $$
$$ \text{Seed} = 0.032 \times 180kg = 5.76kg \approx 5.7kg $$

**Step 2:** Calculate the area occupied by one tree: $$ 5m \times 5m = 25 \text{ m}^2 $$.
**Step 3:** Divide total area by area per tree: $$ 10,000 / 25 = 400 $$.
**Result:** $$ 400 $$ trees.

questions.stem: If the recommended rate for mango tree is $$ 5m \times 5m $$, what will be the number of mango trees in one hectare of land?

**Step 1:** Calculate the area of one hectare: $$ 1 \text{ ha} = 10,000 \text{ m}^2 $$.
**Step 2:** Calculate the area occupied by one tree: $$ 5m \times 5m = 25 \text{ m}^2 $$.
**Step 3:** Divide total area by area per tree: $$ 10,000 / 25 = 400 $$.

similar_questions.stem: If the recommended rate for orange tree is $$ 2.5m \times 2.5m $$, what will be the number of orange trees in **two hectare** of land?
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Calculate the area of one tree.**
Area per tree = $$ 2.5m \times 2.5m = 6.25 m^2 $$

**Step 2: Convert hectares to square meters.**
1 hectare = $$ 10,000 m^2 $$
2 hectares = $$ 20,000 m^2 $$

**Step 3: Calculate the number of trees.**
Number of trees = $$ \frac{\text{Total Area}}{\text{Area per tree}} $$
Number = $$ \frac{20,000}{6.25} = 3200 \text{ trees} $$

similar_questions.stem: If the recommended seeding rate of maize is $$ 180kg $$ per hectare, what will be the amount of seed required in $$ 20m \times 16m $$ land?
explanation_steps:
**Step 1: Calculate the area of the land.**
$$ Area = Length \times Width = 20m \times 16m = 320m^2 $$

**Step 2: Convert hectare to square meters.**
$$ 1 \text{ hectare} = 10,000m^2 $$

**Step 3: Calculate the seed required.**
$$ \text{Seed} = \frac{\text{Area} \times \text{Rate}}{\text{Hectare}} = \frac{320m^2 \times 180kg}{10,000m^2} $$
$$ \text{Seed} = 0.032 \times 180kg = 5.76kg \approx 5.7kg $$
